text: An eastern man in a long coat stood there.
translation: 一个穿长外套的东方男人站在那里。
note: 东方的男人 = 东方人

text: The eastern man spoke a language we could not name.
translation: 那个东方男人说的话我们叫不出名字。
note: 来自东方的人 = 东方人

text: Many eastern men in that old book wear long coats.
translation: 那本旧书里许多东方男子穿着长外套。

text: He wrote about his travels among eastern men.
translation: 他写下了自己在东方人中间的旅行。

text: An eastern church stood on the white hill.
translation: 一座东正教堂立在白色山坡上。
note: 东正教会 = 东正教徒的

text: The eastern church keeps its old gold rules.
translation: 东正教会守着它古老的金色规矩。
note: 东正教会 = 东正教徒的

text: They walked to the eastern church before dark.
translation: 他们天黑前走到了东正教堂。
note: 东正教堂 = 东正教徒的

text: His family came from an eastern church long ago.
translation: 他家族很久以前来自一个东正教会。
note: 东正教会 = 东正教徒的

text: The eastern part of the country is very dry.
translation: 该国东部非常干旱。

text: We stayed in an eastern town near the sea.
translation: 我们住在海边一个东边的镇子。
note: 位于东边的 = 东方的

text: The eastern road is shorter but very crowded.
translation: 东边的路更短但很拥挤。

text: Many eastern cities grew very fast last year.
translation: 去年许多东部城市发展得很快。
note: 东部的城市 = 东方的

text: They went east by train for two long days.
translation: 他们坐火车向东走了整整两天。

text: The wind blew east all through the night.
translation: 风整夜向东吹。

text: Our ship sailed east until the sun rose.
translation: 我们的船向东驶直到日出。

text: Put the map on the table facing east.
translation: 把地图放在桌上朝东。

text: He drew every eastern man with long white hair.
translation: 他把每个留着长白发的东方人都画了出来。

text: They sing the same song as every eastern church.
translation: 他们唱的歌和每个东正教会一样。
note: 东正教会 = 东正教徒的

text: The eastern sky turned pink before six.
translation: 东方的天空在六点前变成了粉色。

text: The road runs east from the old bridge.
translation: 这条路从旧桥向东延伸。
